question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.
sql:
WITH first_terms AS (
  SELECT lt.id_bioguide, lt.term_start::DATE as first_term_start, lt.state, l.gender,
    date_trunc('year', lt.term_start::DATE) + (0 * INTERVAL '1 YEAR') + INTERVAL '1 YEAR' - INTERVAL '1 DAY' as check_date_0,
    date_trunc('year', lt.term_start::DATE) + (2 * INTERVAL '1 YEAR') + INTERVAL '1 YEAR' - INTERVAL '1 DAY' as check_date_2,
    date_trunc('year', lt.term_start::DATE) + (4 * INTERVAL '1 YEAR') + INTERVAL '1 YEAR' - INTERVAL '1 DAY' as check_date_4,
    date_trunc('year', lt.term_start::DATE) + (6 * INTERVAL '1 YEAR') + INTERVAL '1 YEAR' - INTERVAL '1 DAY' as check_date_6,
    date_trunc('year', lt.term_start::DATE) + (8 * INTERVAL '1 YEAR') + INTERVAL '1 YEAR' - INTERVAL '1 DAY' as check_date_8,
    date_trunc('year', lt.term_start::DATE) + (10 * INTERVAL '1 YEAR') + INTERVAL '1 YEAR' - INTERVAL '1 DAY' as check_date_10
  FROM legislators_terms lt
  JOIN legislators l ON lt.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
  WHERE lt.term_number = 0
),
retained AS (
  SELECT ft.id_bioguide, ft.state, ft.gender,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide 
      AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= ft.check_date_0 AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= ft.check_date_0) as retained_0,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide 
      AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= ft.check_date_2 AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= ft.check_date_2) as retained_2,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide 
      AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= ft.check_date_4 AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= ft.check_date_4) as retained_4,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide 
      AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= ft.check_date_6 AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= ft.check_date_6) as retained_6,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide 
      AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= ft.check_date_8 AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= ft.check_date_8) as retained_8,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide 
      AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= ft.check_date_10 AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= ft.check_date_10) as retained_10
  FROM first_terms ft
),
retention_rates AS (
  SELECT state, gender,
    SUM(CASE WHEN retained_0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_0_count,
    COUNT(*) as total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN retained_2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_2_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN retained_4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_4_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN retained_6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_6_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN retained_8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_8_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN retained_10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_10_count
  FROM retained
  GROUP BY state, gender
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT state, gender,
    CASE WHEN total > 0 AND retained_0_count > 0 AND retained_2_count > 0 AND retained_4_count > 0 
        AND retained_6_count > 0 AND retained_8_count > 0 AND retained_10_count > 0 
    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as all_nonzero
  FROM retention_rates
)
SELECT DISTINCT q.state
FROM qualifying q
WHERE q.all_nonzero = 1
  AND q.state IN (
    SELECT q2.state
    FROM qualifying q2
    WHERE q2.all_nonzero = 1
    GROUP BY q2.state
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT q2.gender) = 2
  )
ORDER BY q.state
